title: Cypress fails silently (no error message) after FATAL error
body:
### Current behavior

The fatal system error described in https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/issues/29422 "FATAL:setuid_sandbox_host" is no longer output and Cypress fails silently.

This is a regression from Cypress `14.5.4` 3cbfbe76b02816280e1d9fa5bf1d30e0e39aaaf1

### Desired behavior

If Cypress has a fatal error causing it to exit, then Cypress should at least report that it has failed, and it should preferably also give the reason for the failure in the logs without requiring setting the environment variable `DEBUG=cypress:*`.

### Test code to reproduce

```shell
sudo rm -rf /etc/sysctl.d/60-apparmor-namespace.conf # remove any workaround for "Unprivileged user namespace restrictions"
sudo sysctl --system
git clone https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress
cd cypress
n auto # or set Node.js manually
npm install yarn -g
yarn
yarn start # silent failure
echo "kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0" | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/60-apparmor-namespace.conf # add workaround
sudo sysctl --system
yarn start # Cypress starts
```

Now revert to last v14.x version

```shell
git checkout v14.5.4
sudo rm -rf /etc/sysctl.d/60-apparmor-namespace.conf # remove any workaround for "Unprivileged user namespace restrictions"
sudo sysctl --system
n auto
git clean -xfd
yarn
yarn start # error message "FATAL:setuid_sandbox_host.cc"
echo "kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0" | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/60-apparmor-namespace.conf # add workaround
sudo sysctl --system
yarn start # Cypress starts (with "ERROR:atom_cache.cc")
```


### Cypress Version

First reported on version: `15.0.0` 6db5cb19350db11fe615dfc17a07d09b46a4d8d1
Continues to be reproducible on: `15.1.0` b4ba15e4e9

### Node version

`v22.15.1` LTS

### Operating System

Ubuntu `24.04.3` LTS

### Debug Logs


Logs without `DEBUG`

```text
$ yarn start
yarn run v1.22.22
$ yarn ensure-deps
$ ./scripts/ensure-dependencies.sh
success Folder in sync.
$ cypress open --dev --global
Done in 25.97s.
```

Logs with `DEBUG=cypress:internal-stderr`

```text
$ yarn start
yarn run v1.22.22
$ yarn ensure-deps
$ ./scripts/ensure-dependencies.sh
success Folder in sync.
$ cypress open --dev --global
  cypress:internal-stderr [4853:0826/141709.770519:FATAL:sandbox/linux/suid/client/setuid_sandbox_host.cc:163] The SUID sandbox helper binary was found, but is not configured correctly. Rather than run without sandboxing I'm aborting now. You need to make sure that /home/mike/github/cypress-io/cypress/packages/electron/dist/Cypress/chrome-sandbox is owned by root and has mode 4755. +0ms
Done in 4.62s.
```

### Other
